description:
Activate a basic Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Agatha, returning Ticking Gnomes from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Ticking Gnomes, untapping the basic Swamp.
Activate Ticking Gnomes by sacrificing it.
Repeat.
